summary: Maximus, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026 disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary Maximus Federal Services entered a definitive Equity Purchase Agreement on October 19, 2026 to acquire all outstanding equity of Agile Defense, LLC and certain affiliates from Arclight Equity Holdings, LLC. Consideration is $660 million cash, reduced by Agile indebtedness and transaction expenses, plus up to $50 million of contingent earnout payments tied to revenue milestones over the twelve months post-closing. Expected close is the first quarter of fiscal 2027, subject to HSR clearance and customary conditions; no shareholder vote is required. Watch regulatory timing and purchase-price working-capital adjustments.
